title: Treatment address resolver
summary: Validates and resolves R-{story}-{format}-{approach} catalogue addresses into story, format, approach, intro and motion records; lists a story's ten addresses; confirms the catalogue's 2,400.
evidence_notes: Its pytest suite (8 tests: 2,400 unique addresses, ten per story, group-specific format and approach rules, malformed input) passed in the generator's container on 2026-10-10. Resolving an address joins proposal records; it does not make any treatment a screenplay or a render.
